<!-- Generated by Ankus.DocGenerator. -->

Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Checks conditions inside backend tests, as pgrx tests use <code>assert!</code> and <code>assert_eq!</code>.

```csharp
public static class PgAssert
```

A failed check throws [PgAssertException](/api/ankus.pgassertexception/), which fails the [PgTestAttribute](/api/ankus.pgtestattribute/) method with a
message naming the expected and actual values. Test frameworks such as MSTest do not load inside an extension, so
use these checks in backend code and the framework's own assertions in managed tests.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

### AreEqual(double, double, double, string?)

Checks that two floating-point values differ by no more than a tolerance, as MSTest's <code>Assert.AreEqual</code>
with a delta does.

```csharp
public static void AreEqual(double expected, double actual, double delta, string? message = null)
```

Parameters:

`expected` — [double](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.double)

The expected value.

`actual` — [double](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.double)

The actual value.

`delta` — [double](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.double)

The largest allowed difference; NaN equals NaN.

`message` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

An optional explanation.

Exceptions:

- [PgAssertException](/api/ankus.pgassertexception/): The values differ by more than the tolerance.

### ThrowsExactly&lt;TException&gt;(Action, string?)

Checks that work throws an exception of exactly the given type.

```csharp
public static TException ThrowsExactly<TException>(Action action, string? message = null) where TException : Exception
```

Type parameters:

`TException`

The expected exception type.

Parameters:

`action` — [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action)

The work, which runs in its own subtransaction.

`message` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

An optional explanation.

Returns: <code>TException</code>

The exception.

Exceptions:

- [PgAssertException](/api/ankus.pgassertexception/): The work completed, or threw another exception type.

Running the work in a subtransaction rolls back its changes and any PostgreSQL error, so the test continues
in the same transaction.

### ThrowsSqlState(string, Action, string?)

Checks that work raises a PostgreSQL error with the given SQLSTATE, as a pgrx test's
<code>#[pg_test(error = "...")]</code> expects an error.

```csharp
public static PgException ThrowsSqlState(string sqlState, Action action, string? message = null)
```

Parameters:

`sqlState` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The expected five-character SQLSTATE, such as [DivisionByZero](/api/ankus.pgsqlstates/#member-74d2570f5e0a6869).

`action` — [Action](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.action)

The work, which runs in its own subtransaction.

`message` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

An optional explanation.

Returns: [PgException](/api/ankus.pgexception/)

The error, for checking its message and other fields.

Exceptions:

- [PgAssertException](/api/ankus.pgassertexception/): The work completed, raised another SQLSTATE or threw another exception.
